author: Scott Manley
description:
What happens when you take a Zachtronics game and add nuclear physics? You get Nuclear Design Bureau, a game set in the cold war where you are a physicist trying to make your superiors happy by developing nuclear weapons that meet their needs.

This is not yet released, I have early beta access as some of the bugs are addressed.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4190240/Nuclear_Design_Bureau/
